$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md, at the bank date 2026-11-24. The bank, its customers and their records are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

Dear Anselm Drozdowich,

You wrote to us by email on 18 Nov 2026 about the monthly account fee on your current account ACC-1009-01. You also said that this is not the first time you have written to us about fees.

We looked at your account. The monthly fee of USD 12.00 was taken twice on 16 Nov 2026, which is USD 24.00 for one month. In September and October it was taken once, on 17 September and on 17 October. The second fee should not have been taken. Your complaint is upheld.

We are sorry. You should not have had to write to us about this.

We will refund USD 12.00 to your account ACC-1009-01 on the day this response is sent. Our records do not show why the fee was taken twice, and we will not guess. We will look into it and tell you what we find. Your earlier complaint, CMP-0901, was about a notice of a change to the fee. It is a different matter from this one.

If you are not satisfied with this response, you may take your complaint to the Meridia Financial Ombudsman Service. You must do so within 6 months of this response. It costs you nothing.

You asked for the actual dates and for a straight account of what happened.

Here are the dates from our records. You submitted the payment, PAY-6001, on 18 Nov 2026, and we sent it to the correspondent bank that day. It was held at the correspondent bank, which passes payments between banks. Your friend's bank credited the account on 21 Nov 2026, 3 days after we sent it. The settlement message for the payment has the status ACSC, which means settlement was completed.

Our records show that we sent your payment on the day you made it, and that the time it took was spent at the correspondent bank. We did not lose your money and we found no error by the bank. Your complaint is not upheld. We know how much depended on the deposit, and we are sorry for the worry the wait caused you. Because the bank made no error, we are not able to offer a payment for the delay.

Your payments case, INV-5001, is open and is linked to this complaint.

If you are not satisfied with this response, you may take your complaint to the Meridia Financial Ombudsman Service. You must do so within 6 months of this response. It costs you nothing.

Dear Isolde Pennywhistle,

You wrote to us about your application for a personal loan of USD 14,000, which we declined. You told us that you have a permanent job and have never missed a payment, that the letter gave you no real reason, that you were told in the branch that the application looked fine and that you would hear within five days, that you need the money for furniture and a car, and that you would like us to look at the decision again and to apologise for how your application was handled.

We looked at your application, LAP-8010. It reached us on 2 Nov 2026 and was decided on 10 Nov 2026. Under our lending policy, MTB-POL-030, we compare your monthly debt payments, including the new loan, with your monthly income. Your existing debt payments were USD 700.00 a month and the new loan's monthly payment would have been USD 448.46, against an income of USD 2,400.00. Together the payments come to 0.48 of your income. The limit in the policy is 0.40. That is the reason for the decision.

A declined loan is not a service failure when we have applied our policy to the figures you gave us, and that is what happened here. Your complaint is not upheld. We cannot see from our records what you were told in the branch about how the application looked or how long it would take. We are sorry that the decision was not what you hoped for.

You may ask for the decision to be looked at again. Write to the Credit Review Desk within 30 days, with any new information, and a different credit officer will look again. We cannot promise a different result.

If you are not satisfied with this response, you may take your complaint to the Meridia Financial Ombudsman Service. You must do so within 6 months of this response. It costs you nothing.

Your contact for any further question is [name and direct line to be added before this is sent].

Yours sincerely,
Complaints team
Meridian Trust Bank

We are very sorry for the death of your husband, and sorry that on top of that your card stopped working.
